Fifty more events continuing "Isola — Armor, Weapons, and Inherited Traditions" (events 01-45, shipped as ARMOR-01..45). Same style as yours: "NN. Title — one or two sentences", numbered 46-95.

collection.description: A toolmaker's apprentice is nervous around sharp edges.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (Name1), a toolmaker's apprentice, is nervous around sharp edges. The master starts them with handles, bindings and polishing, and the apprentice discovers they are the best binder in the workshop.
